## Declarations {.unnumbered}

**Funding.** This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

**Conflict of interest.** The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

**Ethics approval (IRB statement).** The study is a secondary analysis of anonymized public-use survey data and did not require review by an institutional review board.

**Consent to participate and for publication.** Not applicable. The study uses anonymized public-use survey data in which respondents gave consent to the survey agencies; no individual can be identified.

**Data availability.** The study uses the public-use files of the OECD Survey of Adult Skills 2023 (PIAAC Cycle 2), which are freely available from the OECD at https://www.oecd.org/skills/piaac/data/. The analysis code, the cached estimates used in the manuscript, and the dated analysis protocol are available at https://github.com/karavan88/NCSJobSatisfPIAAC. The repository does not redistribute the raw OECD files; it lists the files to download and their checksums.
